title: DOM + Runtime Inventory
description: Canonical machine-readable inventory of everything discovered from the application's UI by the DOM + Runtime Discovery Agent. Contains parsed HTML structure, DOM inspection results, form and table analysis, navigation topology, interactive elements, dialog and iframe inventories, and accessibility metadata. Consumed by the Inventory Aggregator for downstream test generation.

runId.description: Globally unique identifier for the test execution run. Must match the runId from the originating test-run-request.json and crawl-package.json.

requestId.description: Correlation identifier from the originating HTTP request. Must match the requestId from the originating test-run-request.json and crawl-package.json.

discoveryMetadata.description: Metadata about the discovery process itself — when it ran, which parsers and DOM engines were used, confidence scores, and any warnings or errors encountered.

pages.description: Inventory of every page that was successfully analysed. Each record contains the discovered page-level metadata: URL, title, type classification, layout structure, language, framework detection, and render mode.

elements.description: Flat inventory of every DOM element discovered across all pages. Elements are normalised into a single flat list and referenced by elementId from forms, tables, navigation, dialogs, and child element arrays. This normalisation ensures a single source of truth for every node.

forms.description: Independent inventory of every HTML form element discovered. Each form record references its controls and submit button by elementId from the elements array. Forms are not embedded inside page records to allow cross-page form analysis.

tables.description: Independent inventory of every HTML table element discovered. Each table record references its header cells and row cells by elementId.

navigation.description: Consolidated navigation inventory across all pages. Captures menus, breadcrumbs, tabs, sidebars, footers, pagination controls, and categorises links as internal or external.

dialogs.description: Inventory of all dialog-like elements discovered: modal dialogs, drawers, popups, alerts, toast notifications, tooltips, and flyouts.

iframes.description: Inventory of every iframe element discovered across all pages.

accessibility.description: Consolidated accessibility analysis across all pages. Captures ARIA roles and labels, heading hierarchy, landmark regions, tab order, keyboard support assessments, contrast issues, and alt-text gaps.

layout.description: Layout-level metadata about the application's rendering environment: viewport dimensions, responsive breakpoints, grid system, CSS framework, and responsive behaviour flags.

pageStatistics.description: Per-page statistics keyed by pageId. Provides at-a-glance quality indicators for each page — element counts, form and table counts, accessibility issue counts, and discovery completeness.
